gloss: to begin writing; to start writing

definitions.gloss: to begin writing; to start writing
definitions.explanation: To start the act of writing — a letter, essay, novel, or any text. A compound verb formed from {書|か}く and {始|はじ}める.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}き{始|はじ}めた。
{彼|かれ}は{高校生|こうこうせい}の{頃|ころ}から{小説|しょうせつ}を{書|か}き{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: He started writing novels when he was in high school.

examples.japanese: {日記|にっき}を{書|か}き{始|はじ}めてから、{毎日|まいにち}が{楽|たの}しくなった。
examples.english: Since I started writing a diary, every day has become more enjoyable.

notes:
A compound verb combining {書|か}く (to write) + {始|はじ}める (to begin). Follows the standard V-stem + {始|はじ}める pattern used to express the beginning of an action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手紙|てがみ}を{書|か}き{始|はじ}める: to start writing a letter
- {小説|しょうせつ}を{書|か}き{始|はじ}める: to start writing a novel
- {日記|にっき}を{書|か}き{始|はじ}める: to start writing a diary
- レポートを{書|か}き{始|はじ}める: to start writing a report

COMPOUND VERB PATTERN:
V-stem + {始|はじ}める is a productive pattern:
- {読|よ}み{始|はじ}める: to start reading
- {食|た}べ{始|はじ}める: to start eating
- {走|はし}り{始|はじ}める: to start running

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {書|か}き{出|だ}す: to begin writing — more spontaneous or sudden onset
- {執筆|しっぴつ}する: to write (professionally) — formal, for authoring books/articles
